integrity: The equilibrium, coefficients, Hurwitz roots and crossing directions are independently recomputed by the included exact-arithmetic script. Literature originality is a qualified self-review, not an exhaustive priority determination.
scientific_limitations: Exact-parameter, local ODE stability only; no nonlinear Hopf normal-form coefficient, global persistence or periodic-orbit existence established. Specialized older effort-dynamics literature could contain an equivalent phase diagram.
title: Reentrant stability under effort-response speed in a selectively harvested predator–prey system
